features.text: Inflated tube bowing out slightly at mid height, rounded shoulders, domed end caps
Two welded vertical seams and a welded flange round each cap
Webbing lifting handle on a welded patch on top
Inflation valve on the top cap
Webbing loop and stainless ring underneath for the anchor line
Scummed band at the waterline (slot MarkScum)

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter of the triangles
